name: trackml-assembly
description: TrackML with a WebAssembly simulation backend — same app, same tracks, same saved AIs, compute in C compiled to wasm32.

scripts.test: npm run test:math && npm run test:autowidth && npm run test:gates && npm run test:race && npm run test:physics && npm run test:version
scripts.test:math: node tools/mathtest.mjs wasm/sim.wasm && node tools/mathtest.mjs wasm/sim-simd.wasm
scripts.test:autowidth: node tools/autowidth.mjs wasm/sim.wasm && node tools/autowidth.mjs wasm/sim-simd.wasm
scripts.test:gates: node tools/checkpoints.mjs wasm/sim.wasm && node tools/checkpoints.mjs wasm/sim-simd.wasm
scripts.test:physics: node tools/carphysics.mjs wasm/sim.wasm && node tools/carphysics.mjs wasm/sim-simd.wasm
